blocks.title: On-demand access
blocks.text: On-demand access means using computing resources whenever needed, without a long setup, like turning on a tap instead of digging a well.
A student who suddenly needs more storage for a school project can rent it instantly from a cloud provider and start using it.

blocks.prompt: Differentiate between elasticity and on-demand access (short question 9).
blocks.explanation: On-demand access is about getting and using resources instantly whenever you ask for them; elasticity is about the system automatically adjusting resources up or down with real-time demand to keep performance and cost right.

items: On-demand: resources instantly when you ask. Elasticity: automatic adjustment to demand.
